g.title: Planner · Plan agent Works out a step-by-step plan for a job. Changes nothing Job: design the fix Now: reading session.ts Reports to: Main, who waits for its report
Main · Coordinator Talks with you, splits the work into jobs, hires helpers and puts their reports together Now: waiting on Planner and Assistant
Researcher · Explore agent Reads and searches, then reports what it found. Changes nothing Job: find the login code Now: handed in its report Reports to: Main, who waits for its report
Assistant · general-purpose agent Can read, edit and run commands to finish one job Job: run the test suite Now: waiting on Researcher 2 Reports to: Main, who waits for its report
Researcher 2 · Explore agent Reads and searches, then reports what it found. Changes nothing Job: find why a test fails Now: being briefed Reports to: Assistant, who waits for its report
